scenes.headline: How a language model writes by unmasking
scenes.sub: iLLaDA: an 8B masked diffusion model, trained from scratch on 12T tokens.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Orbit! Almost every language model writes left to right, one token per pass. iLLaDA fills in a whole block over a few passes. Here's how.

scenes.text: Corrupt text by masking tokens, and train one model to fill them all in. To write, start fully masked and unmask the confident tokens first.
scenes.say: The idea: corrupt text by masking tokens, and train one model to fill them all in. To write, start fully masked, and unmask the confident tokens first.

parts.note: each token masked with probability t, from 0 to 1
parts.say: Pick a ratio t between zero and one, and mask each token with that probability.

parts.note: loss only on masked positions, all predicted at once
parts.say: The model predicts every masked token at once, and only those positions count.

parts.note: reweights light and heavy masking; bounds the negative log-likelihood
parts.say: Dividing by t balances light and heavy masking, so the loss bounds the negative log-likelihood.

scenes.title: Nothing to hide, so no mask on attention

steps.label: Autoregressive: the future is hidden
steps.say: A left-to-right model must hide the future, or it would read the answer.

steps.label: Masked diffusion: every position sees both sides
steps.say: A masked model predicts gaps anywhere, so every position attends left and right.

scenes.title: Writing: a few passes, not one per token

items.text: Start from a block of masks
items.say: To write, start from a block of masks.
Predict every masked position in one pass.
Re-mask the rest and repeat, until the block resolves.

items.text: Append a new block until done
items.say: iLLaDA then appends another mask block, until the answer ends.

left.title: LLaDA
left.say: Over its predecessor LLaDA, iLLaDA is mostly a careful scale-up.

right.title: iLLaDA
items: 12T tokens; fine-tuning masks the whole sequence
right.say: Grouped-query attention for a smaller cache, double the context, and twelve trillion tokens. Fine-tuning now masks prompt and response alike.

scenes.title: Base models, average over 8 benchmarks
scenes.note: after instruction tuning, it still trails Qwen2.5 by about 10 points
scenes.say: As a base model, iLLaDA averages sixty-three point nine, level with Qwen2.5. After instruction tuning, it still trails by about ten points.

scenes.text: Masked diffusion scales like autoregression: bidirectional and from scratch, it reaches base-model parity. The speed case is argued, not yet measured.
scenes.say: Masked diffusion scales like autoregression, all the way to base-model parity. Its speed advantage is still argued, not yet measured.

recap: Train by masking and predicting the originals
Write by unmasking confident tokens over a few passes
At 12T tokens, base-model parity with Qwen2.5
scenes.say: To recap: train by masking, write by unmasking, and scale it up to base-model parity.
